full_judgment: 5. Mr. Amirul Islam, in support of his argument, at first has taken us through the relevant section of the above Ain and thereafter cited two cases, one of Indian jurisdiction and another of our jurisdiction. First case cited by him is the case of State of West Bengal vs Anwar Ali and others as reported in AIR 1952 SC 75. The other case cited is the case of Waris Mea vs State reported in 9 DLR (SC) 117 He has taken us through both the cases and with reference to the case reported in AIR he has submitted that the principle laid down in that case fully applies in the instant cases before us. As he has given much emphasis on the case of the Indian Jurisdiction, let us first consider whether the principles laid down in that case have any manner of application in the instant cases before us.
